title: Why I Stopped Chasing '5am Miracle Mornings'
excerpt: The routine that actually stuck was five minutes long, not five hours.
content:
I tried the 5am routine for exactly eleven days. What actually stuck, a year later, is five minutes of quiet before I open my phone — no cold plunge, no 12-step ritual, just five minutes.

Small and boring beats ambitious and abandoned.

title: The Habit Tracker I Actually Use
excerpt: It has exactly one column, and that's the whole point.
content: Every habit tracker I've tried had too many columns and died within a month. The one that survived has exactly one: did I do the thing, yes or no. That's it.
